newsitem.title: USA: DSP Technology wins $1.2 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: DSP Technology wins $1.2 mln contract.

text.p: DSP Technology Inc Tuesday said it has received a $1.2 million contract to supply General Motors Corp division Saturn Corp with eight turnkey RedLine ADAPT dynamometer control systems.
Saturn will use the products for engine and transmission development and durability testing. DSP will substantially ship the order in the current year.

The RedLine ADAPT powertrain testing product is a real-time control and data acquisition system used for research, development and durability testing of new engines, transmissions and associated drive train components.
